summary: In a Form 6-K filed September 2, 2026, Basel Medical Group announced that directors Fung Keng Leong and Tan Boon Chye stepped down immediately; Darren Tan remains chief commercial officer. Three new directors were appointed, including an independent director. No specific event triggered the change beyond board-approved membership refresh. The filing details director backgrounds but provides no transaction terms, share prices, or advisor involvement. The change appears orderly and board-approved, not forced or abrupt, though director departures with immediate effect signal a governance shift. Watch for subsequent filings indicating strategic direction or further board moves.
